required_scenario_gaps: No bound authentic plan or externally adjudicated normal/risk outcome for any of the three required scenarios.
No directly observed concrete pouring action; concrete-related equipment/structure only.
No unequivocal roadwork scene; roller may be compacting general construction ground.
No defensible possible-idle duration or confirmed idle example.
No natural globally unusable/blurred/dark frame among these selected originals.
No independent trustworthy capture times or verified same-camera temporal series.
No human-adjudicated eight-class precision/recall or localization ground truth.
safe_preparation: Use duplicates of exact same image as explicit synthetic duplicate-invariance cases; retain original hash and do not call them independent observations.
Prepare explicit derived corrupt/blank/blurred cases with source provenance only if needed; these are synthetic robustness tests, not natural photographs.
Use supplied demo plans only as synthetic fixtures, never authentic construction schedule evidence.
